dataset: SeismicPortal FDSN event web service – real-time earthquake catalogue (EMSC-RTS)
description: Near-real-time global earthquake origins M4+ of the past seven days as aggregated by EMSC from more than a hundred contributing seismological agencies, with magnitude, depth, Flinn-Engdahl region and contributing agency.

coverage.geographic: Global for M4+ (the adapter's query); the catalogue is densest in the Euro-Mediterranean region.
coverage.temporal: The seven days before each poll; older events persist locally until retention expires.

updateCadence.upstream: Continuously, within minutes of an earthquake (responses are cacheable for 15 seconds)

attribution: EMSC – European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (SeismicPortal), CC BY 4.0

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
license.notes: Stated on the service documentation page: "The data provided by this service is distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license."

limitations: Real-time solutions are preliminary: location, depth and magnitude are revised as more stations report, and the contributing agency of the preferred solution can change.
Only events of magnitude 4 and larger are requested; smaller events are not shown by this source.
Magnitude types differ between events (mb, ML, Mw, unspecified 'm') and are not strictly comparable.
The service gives no review-status flag, so automatic and analyst-reviewed solutions cannot be told apart.
confidenceNotes: The feed carries no quality or review flag, so records have no confidence value. Severity is derived by this application from magnitude (M4/5/6/7 → minor/moderate/severe/extreme), the same thresholds as the USGS layer.

retention.note: Events are kept for 45 days after they occurred, then purged.

layers.name: Earthquakes (EMSC)
layers.description: Earthquakes M4+ of the past week from the EMSC real-time catalogue (independent of USGS; strongest in Europe and the Mediterranean).
